notes: אַף כִּי is split rather than fused: the ASV spends *How much more* on אַף and *when* on כִּי, so each morpheme has a rendering of its own (rules 2, 30).
The article of שְׁפָטַי הָרָעִים is unrepresented: the phrase's one determiner is *my*, licensed by the suffix (rule 41's limit).
The *the*s before *sword*, *famine*, *beasts* and *pestilence* are supplied, no article morpheme standing on those nouns (rule 15).
